versions.content: The verification of the certificate(s) shall be done asyn- chronously. All certificates that are involved in the chain of trust shall be verified, from top to bottom. The callback function KeyM_CertificateVerifyCallbackNotification() shall be called if the verification has been finished and provide the result of the operation in the callback.
